msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia chic-and-txik-47.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of many colourful mirror acrylic half-moon earrings in pink, blue, purple, green and gold from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia chic-and-txik-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of geometric acrylic stud earrings made of two overlapping triangles in mirror orange and coral, on a kraft card from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia chic-and-txik-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of burgundy acrylic petal earrings with two overlapping leaves, on a kraft card from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia chic-and-txik-27.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of square acrylic earrings layered in burgundy and red, on a kraft card from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia chic-and-txik-39.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of blue heart-shaped acrylic earrings with a silver mirror inner heart from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
